neighbours.label: a slot predicting a versatility or multiplicity word: 'a man of many', 'wide-ranging', 'multi-', 'do-all' (output promotes versatile, diverse, variety)
fire: The museum hired a woman of many talents to run its education programme.
The governor has wide-ranging powers over the state budget.
This multipurpose blade can slice, dice and peel with ease.
He was a multitalented performer who sang, danced and acted.
The new phone is a true jack-of-all-trades device for travellers.
The job covers many different duties across three departments.
Her multifaceted career spans law, music and journalism.
The committee has broad and varied responsibilities for the campus.
quiet: The museum hired a woman with a degree to run its education programme.
The governor has limited powers over the state budget.
This small blade can only slice bread with ease.
He was a famous performer who sang at the opera.
The new phone is a simple, cheap device for travellers.
The job covers one clearly defined duty in one department.
Her short career was spent entirely in a single law firm.
The committee has a single narrow responsibility for the car park.

notes: Near misses keep the frame but describe a single or narrow role.
